default.title: Page not found
default.description: We're sorry, we can't find the page you're looking for.
default.guidance: Check the address for typing errors, or use one of the options below.
default.supportText: If you followed a link to this page, tell us where you found it.

id.description: ID for the Page root and its heading reference. The default supports a standard skip link; override it when another element already uses main-content.

title.description: Plain-language h1 that summarizes the problem without blaming the user.

description.default: We’re sorry. Please try again later.
description.description: Short lead text that explains what happened in user-facing language.

guidance.description: Optional recovery guidance rendered as a paragraph before the actions.

actions.description: Ordered navigation actions. Each item must provide label and href. Links work without JavaScript; callback-only actions belong in a framework adapter outside this shared component.

items.description: A link rendered with the USX Button component inside a ButtonGroup. Labels must disclose when a destination opens in a new tab.

itemClassName.description: Additional CSS classes for the list item around this action.

supportText.description: Optional instructions shown with the support channels.

supportLinks.description: Optional help links, including web, mailto, or tel destinations.

items.description: A support channel rendered with the USX Link component. Labels should disclose when a destination opens a new window.

cats.description: When true and errorCode has a value, displays the corresponding http.cat illustration after the description. This makes an external browser request to https://http.cat and may require that origin in the host Content Security Policy img-src directive.

catAlt.description: Optional localized alt text for the cat illustration. When omitted, the component uses 'Cat illustration for HTTP error {errorCode}'.

errorCode.description: Optional public error or HTTP status code, displayed as subordinate metadata. This prop does not set the response status.

referenceId.description: Optional opaque identifier that a user can give support. Do not include secrets, session IDs, stack traces, or raw request data.

detailsProps.description: Optional Details disclosure rendered after support and public metadata with monospace font utilities. Supply its label through `detailsProps.summaryProps.label` and use escaped plain text or trusted composed children. When supplying diagnostics, authorize the viewer and redact sensitive values first. A closed disclosure is still present in the page source.

children.description: Optional trusted, composed recovery content rendered after guidance and before actions. Use React nodes or a Django block with equivalent markup.

className.description: Additional CSS classes for the root Page element.
